Cookie values are never\n// printed, logged, or cached: they are only counted.\nimport * as commander from \"browser-commander\";\n\nimport { detectDefaultBrowser } from \"./default-browser.mjs\";\n\n/** Browser Commander's cookie sources, should a release stop exporting them. */\nconst FALLBACK_SOURCES = [\"chrome\", \"edge\", \"brave\", \"chromium\", \"firefox\"];\n/** `--browser-import` values that pick the source browser for the user. */\nexport const IMPORT_CHOICES = [\"default\", \"auto\"];\n/** `--browser-import-scope` values. */\nexport const IMPORT_SCOPES = [\"domains\", \"full\"];\n\n/** The domains whose cookies hold each registry's sign-in. */\nexport const SIGN_IN_DOMAINS = {\n  \"crates-io\": [\"crates.io\", \"github.com\"],\n  npm: [\"npmjs.com\"],\n  pypi: [\"pypi.org\", \"github.com\"],\n};\n\n/** Display names of the source browsers, as the default-browser query names them. */\nconst SOURCE_NAMES = {\n  chrome: \"Google Chrome\",\n  edge: \"Microsoft Edge\",\n  brave: \"Brave\",\n  chromium: \"Chromium\",\n  firefox: \"Firefox\",\n};\n\n/**\n * Every browser `--browser-import` can read, from Browser Commander. Each entry is\n * `{ browser, profile, label, domains }`; cookie values are discarded.\n */\nexport async function findSignInSources(domains, options = {}) {\n  const list = options.listProfiles ?? commander.listBrowserProfiles;\n  const read = options.readCookies ?? commander.readBrowserCookies;\n  const preferred = options.defaultSource;\n  const browsers = (options.sources ?? importSources()).toSorted(\n    (left, right) => Number(right === preferred) - Number(left === preferred),\n  );\n  const found = [];\n  for (const browser of browsers) {\n    const profiles = await list({ browser }).catch(() => []);\n    for (const profile of profiles) {\n      const matched = [];\n      for (const domain of domains) {\n        const cookies = await read({\n          browser,\n          profile: profile.path,\n          domainFilter: domain,\n          ignoreDecryptionErrors: true,\n          cache: false,\n        }).catch((error) => {\n          if (options.verbose) {\n            console.error(\n              `could not read ${browser} cookies for ${domain}: ${error.message}`,\n            );\n          }\n          return [];\n        });\n        if (cookies.length > 0) {\n          matched.push(domain);\n        }\n      }\n      if (matched.length > 0) {\n        const name = profile.displayName ?? Returns the chosen source or\n * `undefined`.\n */\nexport async function chooseSignInSource(sources, domains, ask, auto) {\n  if (sources.length === 0) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n  const [first] = sources;\n  const question = `Import your ${domains.join(\" / \")} sign-in from ${first.label} into the automated profile?`;\n  if (auto) {\n    console.log(`  ${question} yes (--browser-import auto)`);\n    return first;\n  }\n  if (sources.length > 1) {\n    sources.forEach((source, index) =>\n      console.log(`  ${index + 1}. ${source.label} (${source.domains.join(\", \")})`),\n    );\n  }\n  const choices = sources.length > 1 ? `[Y/n/1-${sources.length}]` : \"[Y/n]\";\n  const answer = String(await ask(`${question} ${choices} `)).trim();\n  if (/^(?:n|no)$/i.test(answer)) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n  const index = Number(answer);\n  return Number.isInteger(index) && index >= 1 && index <= sources.length\n    ? sources[index - 1]\n    : first;\n}\n\n/**\n * Resolves `--browser-import default|auto` to an installed source browser:\n * the system default browser, or for `auto` the first browser with a\n * sign-in for `domains`. Throws when `default` names a browser Browser\n * Commander cannot read yet, such as Safari.\n */\nexport async function resolveImportChoice(choice, domains, options = {}) {\n  const preferred = await defaultSource(options);\n  if (choice === \"default\") {\n    if (!preferred) {\n      throw new Error(\n        \"--browser-import default: the default browser cannot be imported yet (Browser Commander reads \" +\n          `${importSources().join(\", \")}; see link-foundation/browser-commander#114)`,\n      );\n    }\n    return { browser: preferred, profile: null };\n  }\n  const [found] = await findSignInSources(domains, {\n    ...options,\n    defaultSource: preferred,\n  });\n  return found ? { browser: found.browser, profile: found.profile } : null;\n}\n",

let (browser, profile) = match spec.split_once(':') {\n        Some((browser, profile)) => (browser, Some(profile)),\n        None => (spec, None),\n    };\n    if !IMPORT_BROWSERS.contains(&browser) || profile == Some(\"\") {\n        bail!(\"--browser-import must be <chrome|edge|brave|firefox>[:profile]\");\n    }\n    Ok(ImportSource {\n        browser: browser.to_owned(),\n        profile: profile.map(str::to_owned),\n    })\n}\n\n/// Parses `snapshot`, `snapshot:<profile>`, or `extension`.\npub fn parse_attach(spec: &str) -> Result<AttachMode> {\n    match spec {\n        \"extension\" => Ok(AttachMode::Extension),\n        \"snapshot\" => Ok(AttachMode::Snapshot { profile: None }),\n        _ => match spec\n            .strip_prefix(\"snapshot:\")\n            .filter(|profile| !profile.is_empty())\n        {\n            Some(profile) => Ok(AttachMode::Snapshot {\n                profile: Some(profile.to_owned()),\n            }),\n            None => {\n                bail!(\"--browser-attach must be 'snapshot', 'snapshot:<profile>', or 'extension'\")\n            }\n        },\n    }\n}\n\n/// Builds the preferences object from `key=value` pairs. Dotted keys nest, and\n/// a value is JSON when it parses as JSON, otherwise a string.\npub fn parse_preferences(pairs: &[String]) -> Result<Value> {\n    let key_pattern = Regex::new(r\"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*$\")?;\n    let mut preferences = Map::new();\n    for pair in pairs {\n        let (key, value) = pair.split_once('=').unwrap_or((\"\", \"\"));\n        if !key_pattern.is_match(key) {\n            bail!(\"--browser-pref must be key=value, got '{pair}'\");\n        }\n        let mut parts: Vec<&str> = key.split('.').collect();\n        let last = parts.pop().unwrap_or_default();\n        let mut target = &mut preferences;\n        for part in parts {\n            let entry = target\n                .entry(part.to_owned())\n                .or_insert_with(|| Value::Object(Map::new()));\n            if !entry.is_object() {\n                *entry = Value::Object(Map::new());\n            }\n            let Value::Object(next) = entry else {\n                unreachable!(\"the entry was just made an object\")\n            };\n            target = next;\n        }\n        target.insert(last.to_owned(), preference_value(value));\n    }\n    Ok(Value::Object(preferences))\n}\n\nfn preference_value(text: &str) -> Value {\n    serde_json::from_str(text).unwrap_or_else(|_| Value::String(text.to_owned()))\n}\n\n/// Rejects a restriction or preset that is not in the shared catalogue.\npub fn validate_restrictions(names: &[String]) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n    let known = restriction_names();\n    let mut unique = Vec::new();\n    for name in names {\n        if !known.contains(name) {\n            bail!(\n                \"unknown --browser-restriction '{name}'; choose from {}\",\n                known.join(\", \")\n            );\n        }\n        if !unique.contains(name) {\n            unique.push(name.clone());\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(unique)\n}\n\n/// The installed browser a snapshot copies for a launch channel.\n#[must_use]\npub fn snapshot_browser(channel: &str) -> &str {\n    if channel.starts_with(\"msedge\") {\n        \"edge\"\n    } else if matches!(channel, \"brave\" | \"chromium\") {\n        channel\n    } else {\n        \"chrome\"\n    }\n}\n\n/// Describes where forms are filled, for the browser prerequisite.\n#[must_use]\npub fn automated_description(\n    channel: &str,\n    profile: Option<&str>,\n    attach: Option<&AttachMode>,\n    import: Option<&ImportSource>,\n) -> String {\n    match attach {\n        Some(AttachMode::Extension) => {\n            \"your own browser through the Browser Commander extension\".to_owned()\n        }\n        Some(AttachMode::Snapshot { profile }) => format!(\n            \"a temporary snapshot of your {} profile {}\",\n            snapshot_browser(channel),\n            profile.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"Default\")\n        ),\n        None => {\n            let location = profile\n                .map(|profile| format!(\" at {profile}\"))\n                .unwrap_or_default();\n            let imported = import\n                .map(|source| {\n                    let profile = source\n                        .profile\n                        .as_ref()\n                        .map(|profile| format!(\":{profile}\"))\n                        .unwrap_or_default();\n                    format!(\" with data imported from {}{profile}\", source.browser)\n                })\n                .unwrap_or_default();\n            format!(\"the automated {channel} profile{location}{imported}\")\n        }\n    }\n}\n54-    Inspect,\n55-    /// Produce an ordered, machine-readable registry setup plan.\n56:    Plan {\n57-        /// Restrict plans to one or more registries. \"workflow_filename\": publisher.workflow,\n            \"environment\": publisher.environment.as_deref().filter(|name| !name.is_empty()),\n        }\n    })\n}\n\n/// A script that calls the Value::String(detail) => detail.clone(),\n        other => other.to_string(),\n    }\n}\n\n/// The question asked once before the token is created.\n#[must_use]\npub fn first_publish_question(\n
